sundar_pichai.name: Sundar Pichai
sundar_pichai.ref_text: Good morning everyone and welcome to Google I/O. It is an incredible time for technology, and we are thrilled to share our latest breakthroughs with you today.

sam_altman.name: Sam Altman
sam_altman.ref_text: Welcome to OpenAI DevDay. Today we are launching new capabilities that will allow developers to build incredible AI applications.

jensen_huang.name: Jensen Huang
jensen_huang.ref_text: Welcome to GTC. The computer graphics industry and artificial intelligence have reached an extraordinary inflection point.

demis_hassabis.name: Demis Hassabis
demis_hassabis.ref_text: At Google DeepMind, our mission is to build artificial general intelligence responsibly to benefit humanity and solve the hardest scientific challenges.

mark_zuckerberg.name: Mark Zuckerberg
mark_zuckerberg.ref_text: Welcome to Meta Connect. We believe that open source AI is the right path forward for the entire industry and ecosystem.

elon_musk.name: Elon Musk
elon_musk.ref_text: At xAI, our fundamental goal is to understand the true nature of the universe and build AI that accelerates human scientific discovery.

satya_nadella.name: Satya Nadella
satya_nadella.ref_text: Welcome to Microsoft Ignite. We are seeing a profound shift in how software and compute empower every organization on the planet.

dario_amodei.name: Dario Amodei
dario_amodei.ref_text: At Anthropic, we focus on building reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems with constitutional AI principles.
